annotations.title: x402 payment-terms decoder (v1 body + v2 header)

description: [Kyreos, 0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Give any x402 URL; returns decoded price, asset, network, payTo and input schema from the header or the 402 body, so your agent can pay or skip it. Input: {"url":"https://..."}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/x402-v2-decode?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.005 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.005 USDC on Base)
